title: The Privacy-Utility Tradeoff in Rank-Preserving Dataset Obfuscation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of privacy and utility (rank-preservation) in dataset obfuscation. Privacy is quantified as information leakage (mutual information) and utility as Kendall's Rank Correlation Coefficient (KRCC). While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper deals with optimizing technical mechanisms and their performance limits, not the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, morals, religion, or faith.
